snippet.title: Full Release Trailer | Star Chef Simulator
snippet.description:
We've finally released the full version of Star Chef Simulator today! v1.0.0 is now available for download: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956720/Star_Chef_Simulator/

Have you ever dreamed of running your own restaurant? Then your dream is about to come true! Set up and manage your restaurant with staff, equipment and more in Star Chef Simulator - available on Steam.

2026 Star Chef Simulator published by Pinguin Games and developed by Division Software
Music created with Udio
